criteria.statement: Repository announcement discovery on Services preserves and uses configured nostr.nip34_relays for kind 30617 queries when available.
Repository discovery does not call nostr.connect with NIP-07/user relay lists and does not replace the global Bahia singleton relay connection.

The Bahia sidecar accepts read filters for all NIP-34 kinds from the local NIP-34 spec plus NIP-22 comments used for NIP-34 replies, and accepts signed repository announcement publishes as open interop events.
Frontend and backend NIP-34 kind constants remain drift-checked between internal/kinds/kinds.go and web/src/lib/nostr/kinds.gen.js.
